verdict.rationale: Nitrokey 3 is documented as an OpenPGP smart card that can generate keys on the device. Its OpenPGP-card docs include a Thunderbird section, which covers encrypted email. Git commit signing is never mentioned, and the evidence consists only of section titles. missing for 10: documented git commit signing workflow, in-depth OpenPGP email setup docs beyond a section title, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep OpenPGP keys on the device and use them for git commit signing and encrypted email
